record.one_liner: Otter.ai is a meeting transcription and conversation intelligence app; its Public API exposes channels, conversations, transcripts and workspace data.
record.auth_notes: Public API uses a Bearer API key created under Integrations > Developer (max 2 keys per user). The MCP server separately uses OAuth to connect AI clients; that is not the public API auth.
record.access_notes: critic: access paid_plan -> contact_sales. Public API is only for Enterprise workspaces; Enterprise has no public price (demo-only) and the docs tell you to contact your Otter account manager if the feature is missing. No free, trial, Pro or Business path to the API.
record.api_notes: Documented endpoints under https://api.otter.ai/v1 cover channels, conversations, workspace, transcripts, audio, action items, insights and outlines. Enterprise plan rate limit is 10 requests per second.
record.blocker_notes: critic: main_blocker paid_plan -> contact_sales. API keys are gated to the Enterprise plan, obtained via an account manager rather than self-serve checkout. The official MCP server exists but needs OAuth sign-in to an Otter account, not a developer credential path.
